Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane


Performance Media Executive (also known as Performance Executive, Digital Activation Executive, Paid Search Executive, Senior Performance Executive, Senior Performance Media Executive)  
  
Role Overview   
The purpose of the Performance Media Executive is to assist in the implementation and management of industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers. This role exists to support the Performance Media team across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation.  
   
Skills & Experience  
•	This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.   
•	Supporting Account Managers and Directors across the team to deliver across account deliverables including reporting, optimisation tactics, copy-writing, quality-checks and best practice  
•	Own campaign execution in support to your Account Manager and Director, delivery and execution of a given customer campaign and/or account  
•	Assist in the development of insights for reporting, laddering up to the ‘so-what?’   
•	Own the building of new Search, Programmatic, Social campaign accounts ensuring a high level of detail is observed and we are aligned to the customer brief.  
•	Own the loading of monthly budgets and management of budget pacing through the month with Performance Media Coordinators.  
•	Own in the loading of proposed budgets into our invoicing system accurately and reconciling budgets on a monthly basis.   
•	Identify areas for account improvement and feed-back to Performance Media Managers and Directors and into Coordinators.  
•	Basic-Intermediate (12-24 months minimum) understanding and working knowledge of either SEM, Paid Social or Programmatic campaign build and/or management.  
•	Basic-Intermediate (6-24 months) understanding of Google or Adobe Analytics  
•	Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel   
•	Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint and Outlook)  
  
Salary: $85K - $90K package 


Performance Manager (Also known as Performance Media Manager, Associate Activation Manager, Digital Activation Manager, Paid Search Manager, Search Manager, Paid Social Manager, Social Manager, Programmatic Manager)

The purpose of the Performance Media Account Manager is to manage the delivery of industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers/clients.
This role exists to deliver, with the support of the wider Performance Media team, across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation that drives business outcomes for our customers.
Managing responsibilities of Executives and/or Coordinators to ensure account deliverables including reporting, optimisation tactics, copywriting, quality-checks and best practice. This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 3-4 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Performance marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Excellent ability to analyse and manipulate data, extracting insights for reporting.
Salary: $85K - $110K package

Performance Director (Also known as Performance Media Director, Associate Activation Director, Digital Activation Director, Senior Search Manager, Search Director, Senior Paid Social Manager, Social Director, Programmatic Director)
The purpose of the Performance Director is to define industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers and also responsible for ensuring the best possible ROI for a client’s digital/performance media investment. This role exists to deliver, with the Performance Media team, across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation that drives business outcomes for our customers/clients. Own the mid to senior customer relationship to ensure we are aligned with the customer and delivering on their business needs. Full responsibility for people management and account management/implementation within your team, and ensuring campaigns deliver against client KPIs. Responding to and presenting new business pitches.
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Performance marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Leadership and mentoring of performance digital teams 
Salary: $110K - $140K package

All roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.

Position: Retail Manager
Type: Full-time
Employer: IN2 FONES PTY LTD
Location: Mount Vernon NSW 2178
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business:
IN2 FONES PTY LTD is a dynamic and expanding telecommunications retail business that operates multiple Vodafone-branded stores and customer service operations across New South Wales. With a recent growth to approximately 10 stores, the company specialises in delivering high-quality mobile phones, tablets, smart watches, service plans, accessories, and repair services to a diverse customer base. Known for its strong focus on customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and market competitiveness, IN2 FONES fosters a supportive and performance-driven workplace culture that values teamwork, professional development, and innovation in the fast-paced retail telecom sector.
About the Position:
The Retail Manager plays a pivotal leadership role in overseeing the day-to-day operations of three telecommunications retail stores within IN2 FONES PTY LTD. This position is responsible for driving sales, profitability, and operational efficiency while implementing strategic initiatives to enhance market presence and customer experience. The role is essential for supporting the company’s continued expansion and achieving business objectives in a competitive retail environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Direct and control the day-to-day operations of three telecommunications retail stores to ensure the achievement of sales, profitability and operational objectives.
Determine product mix, pricing strategies and stock levels for mobile phones, tablets, smart watches, telecommunications service plans, accessories and repair services in accordance with market demand and business objectives.
Develop and implement purchasing, sales and marketing strategies, including promotional campaigns and bundled product offers, to increase revenue and strengthen market competitiveness.
Manage procurement, inventory planning, stock control, stock reconciliation and loss prevention across all retail locations to ensure product availability and minimise inventory shrinkage.
Analyse sales reports, financial results and key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify business trends, improve operational efficiency and maximise profitability.
Prepare and manage store budgets, monitor operating expenses and implement cost-control measures to achieve financial performance targets.
Recruit, supervise, train, roster and manage the performance of retail staff across all store locations to ensure operational efficiency and achievement of business objectives.
Oversee visual merchandising, product displays and promotional activities to maximise product visibility, sales performance and brand consistency.
Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety legislation, company policies, retail procedures and all relevant regulatory requirements.
Liaise with senior management to implement business strategies, improve operational processes and support the continued commercial growth of the business.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Diploma level qualification (or equivalent).
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience.
Proven leadership and team management skills with the ability to recruit, train, motivate and develop retail staff.
Strong commercial acumen, including experience in sales target achievement, inventory management, budgeting, and profit optimisation.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a customer-focused mindset and ability to build positive relationships.
Analytical skills to interpret sales data, KPIs, and financial reports to drive informed decision-making.
Knowledge of retail operations in telecommunications or a similar fast-paced consumer goods environment.
Commitment to compliance, workplace health and safety, and high ethical standards.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Generators Australia is a leading supplier of Solar and Hybrid Lighting Towers, Hybrid and Diesel Generators, Mobile AC Batteries, Solar CCTV and Diesel Compressors. Our core business facilitates the rental and capital sales of these products across Australia.
Generators Australia's incorporation of ground-breaking technology in renewable products utilising Lithium and Solar provide value-based solutions across a wide range of Industries, including Construction, Rail, Civil Infrastructure and Mining.
We believe in creating a welcoming culture which is centered around our company values - People, Safety, Respect, Communication and Continuous Improvement.
Our growth in Solar/Hybrid Lighting and Power products across Australia has continued to exceed expectations, so we are now looking for a qualified Electrician with some experience in working with solar to join our St Marys team.
This role is full-time and will be paying between $110,000.00 and $130,000.00 per annum.
Other responsibilities will include:
•	Maintaining our Hybrid, Solar and Diesel-Powered assets
•	Test and Tagging of all equipment and other assets
•	Minor electrical Installations
•	Overall technical electrical support
•	Responsible for performing scheduled and breakdown electrical and mechanical maintenance on our fleet of equipment.
•	Diagnosing and rectifying electrical issues on all assets
•	Where required, undertake mechanical maintenance and repairs
•	Maintaining a strong safety focus.
•	Hours will be 7am to 5pm. Monday to Friday.
The successful candidate will be an individual who will honour our core value of People, Safety, Respect, Communication and Continuous Improvement - in addition to this they will have:
•	Qualified Electrician with a recognised electrical trade qualification and the ability to obtain the required Australian electrical licence.
•	Valid Driver's License.
•	Minimum of 2 years' experience as a Tradesperson.
•	Ability to carry out basic electrical fault diagnosis and rectification.
•	Experience in electrical installation and commissioning, servicing, periodical inspections, preventative maintenance, and repairs to Generators Australia's equipment to meet both manufacture and company standards.
•	Experience working with Batteries, Inverters, Solar systems, EV Chargers and Diesel Engines
•	Ability to travel to East coast branches to provide overall technical support when required
•	Strong communication skills.
The Benefits of Joining Generators Australia
•	A competitive remuneration package aligned with your experience and qualifications.
•	Fully maintained company vehicle, fuel card, laptop and mobile phone.
•	The opportunity to work for a well-established and secure organisation.
•	On-going training and development
•	Inspirational leadership that is eager to help you succeed.
•	Employee Reward & Recognition programs to celebrate your successes.
•	Company Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support mental health.
•	A positive workplace with an ongoing commitment to continuous improvement and development
•	A safe workplace with a strong focus on ZERO harm - Every day
How to Apply
This is a great opportunity to work in a progressive and dynamic team within a secure and stable industry. If you feel that you have the experience, ability, and skills, we want to hear from you!
Click "Apply Now" and upload an updated copy of your resume and cover letter.
At Generators Australia, we recognize that we are strengthened by diversity. We are committed to providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and encourage women and Indigenous candidates to apply.

result.description: Zenithra Holdings Pty Ltd   You Are Hired  is seeking a skilled and customer-focused  Electronic Equipment Trades Worker (ANZSCO 342313)  on behalf of our client,  A H R Mobile Pty Ltd .  About the Business:  A H R Mobile Pty Ltd operates a network of fast-paced retail outlets and kiosks located in shopping centres across Melbourne region. We specialize in on-the-spot mobile phone and tablet repairs, alongside selling a wide range of mobile accessories and protective gear.  About the Role:  In this dual-focused technical role, you will work directly from our retail outlets or kiosk stations, providing fast, reliable electronic repair services while assisting everyday shoppers. You will handle everything from basic component replacements to intricate logic board diagnostics and micro-soldering, while also upselling mobile accessories to store customers.  Work Structure: Full-time (38 hours per week).  Roster: Rotating roster aligned with shopping centre trading hours (including Thursday/Friday late-night trading and weekends).  Mobility: You must be flexible and willing to travel between various shopping centre locations in Melbourne region as scheduled.   Benefits   Competitive Salary: Market-aligned salary package + Superannuation (commensurate with trade experience).   Travel Allowance: Mileage/travel reimbursement provided when traveling between locations during work shifts.   Staff Discounts: Generous employee discounts on phone accessories, parts, and hardware.   Dynamic Work Environment: Engage directly with customers in vibrant, high-foot-traffic shopping centres.   Skills Development: Ongoing training in advanced micro-soldering and technical repair methods for the latest mobile device models.    Task & responsibilities   Device Diagnosis & Repair: Inspect, test, and troubleshoot faulty mobile phones, tablets, and wearable devices at the workbench using specialized diagnostic tools.   Component-Level Benchwork: Perform precise hardware repairs, including screen replacements, battery swaps, charging port repairs, speaker fixes, and micro-soldering on printed circuit boards (PCBs).   Accessory Sales & Customer Service: Greet customers, answer inquiries, and recommend/upsell mobile phone accessories (e.g., cases, screen protectors, chargers, and audio gear).   Quality Assurance: Test all repaired devices thoroughly before handing them back to the customer to ensure network and performance standards are met.   Workbench & Inventory Maintenance: Keep the workbench ESD-safe, clean, and organized, while managing stock levels for repair parts and retail accessories.   Multi-Site Coverage: Travel between designated shopping centre kiosks to cover shifts and manage repair volume during peak trading periods.    Qualification & experience   Qualifications:     AQF Certificate III in Electronics and Communications (UEE30920), Electrotechnology, or equivalent trade qualification; OR   At least 3 years of relevant hands-on trade experience in electronic equipment/mobile device repair (as per ANZSCO 342313 standards).     Technical Skills: Proven trade experience in mobile hardware diagnosis, precision hand-tool usage, micro-soldering, and PCB repair.   Customer & Sales Skills: Friendly, approachable attitude with experience in retail sales and customer service.   Flexibility & Mobility: Full availability for a rotating roster (including weekend retail hours) and a valid Driver’s License with reliable transport to move between shopping centre locations.   Communication: Excellent verbal and written English skills to interact with kiosk customers and document repair jobs clearly. Web Designer
Location: Balaclava, Melbourne, VIC (Full-time, Permanent)
Salary range: 80,000 - 85,000.

About TAG

TAG is a Melbourne-based full-service digital marketing agency partnering with businesses to drive growth through strategy, creative, paid media, websites, CRM and digital transformation. Our head office is located in Balaclava, Melbourne, where this full-time position is based.

We're looking for an experienced Web Designer to join our growing team and create exceptional digital experiences that deliver both outstanding user experiences and measurable commercial outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

*Consult with clients and internal stakeholders to understand project objectives, business goals and user requirements.
*Plan, design and produce website layouts, wireframes, prototypes and user interfaces.
*Create visually engaging, responsive website designs with a strong focus on user experience (UX), user interface (UI) and accessibility.
*Develop creative concepts, page layouts and digital assets tailored to each client's brand and target audience.
*Collaborate with developers, strategists and project managers to ensure accurate implementation of approved designs.
*Prepare and maintain design documentation, style guides and design systems.
*Review websites throughout the production process to ensure quality, consistency and functionality.
*Conduct website audits and recommend improvements to usability, performance and conversion.
*Stay up to date with emerging web design trends, technologies and industry best practices.

Skills & Experience

*Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Web Design, Digital Design, Graphic Design or a related discipline.
*Demonstrated experience designing responsive websites with a strong portfolio of UI/UX work.
*Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite and modern web design platforms such as Webflow.
*Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards and user-centred design principles.
*Excellent communication, organisational and stakeholder management skills.
*Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver high-quality work within deadlines.

Most of your work will be based in Adelaide, with occasional travel to regional areas including the Riverland and Port Augusta.

Mechanical aptitude and practical problem-solving skills

Excellent communication and customer service skills

If you're looking for a stable, full-time role with excellent conditions and the opportunity to work independently in a well-equipped service vehicle, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of a team that values quality work, reliability, and great customer service!
